result.target_summary: Intel sells primarily to OEMs, ODMs, cloud service providers, and other manufacturers through distributors, resellers, and retail channels, with ODMs providing design and manufacturing services to private-label resellers.

target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures describe Intel's primary sales channels, specifically identifying OEMs, ODMs, and cloud service providers as key customers. The 2024 text expands slightly on direct/indirect channels but retains the same core subject of customer type classification.

Both disclosures describe Intel's reseller sales channel structure, specifically mentioning thousands of indirect customers (systems builders) purchasing from distributors and the availability of products in direct retail outlets. The 2024 disclosure (intc_2024_7_D157) contains identical phrasing regarding the reseller channel and retail outlets, confirming the same specific topic.

comparisons.peer_topic: Software Customer Base and Sales Channels
comparisons.peer_summary: Software customers are typically large enterprises with complex, multi-vendor environments. Solutions are sold directly, through resellers, distributors, hyperscale cloud providers, and VMware partners, with a focus on strengthening relationships and promoting an enterprise-wide license model.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies describe their distribution channels as involving a mix of direct sales and indirect channels such as resellers, distributors, and partners. Intel notes its products are sold through distributor, reseller, retail, and OEM channels, while Broadcom (via VMware) makes its infrastructure solutions available directly, through resellers, distributors, hyperscale cloud providers, and partners, highlighting a similar multi-channel go-to-market structure.

sentences.text: In addition, our customers include other manufacturers and service providers, such as industrial and communication equipment manufacturers and cloud service providers who buy our products through distributor, reseller, retail, and OEM channels throughout the world.

Our private cloud infrastructure suite of solutions are available directly from Broadcom, resellers and distributors, hyperscale cloud providers, value-added OEMs and VMware cloud service provider partners.

comparisons.peer_summary: Customers include public cloud providers, consumer internet companies, enterprises, startups, public sector entities, OEMs, ODMs, system integrators, AIBs, and distributors.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA identify OEMs and ODMs as key customer segments within their direct and indirect customer bases. Intel explicitly states it sells primarily to OEMs, ODMs, and cloud service providers, while NVIDIA lists customers including public cloud providers, OEMs, ODMs, system integrators, and distributors, indicating a shared reliance on these intermediate manufacturing and channel partners in the semiconductor ecosystem.
